prompt:
Work from the styled table shown in the image: a spreadsheet-style table with one Name column, several year columns in chronological order, full grid lines, and a shaded header row. Read the named row over time and report the requested integer result. Read the values for row Dino in 2019 and 2022. What is 2022 minus 2019?
Return a valid JSON object with keys "evidence" and "answer" in that order.
Evidence requirement: set "evidence" to an array containing exactly two bounding boxes [x1, y1, x2, y2] ordered as [start-year cell, end-year cell].
Answer format: set "answer" to the exact integer temporal result.
Example JSON:
{"evidence":[[260,180,372,236],[374,180,486,236]],"answer":-4}
